weekend_note: A dry, cool stretch: highs in the low-to-mid 70s with essentially no rain through Tuesday, though Saturday morning lows are near 47, so bring a layer. The earlier rain signal for Tue-Wed has faded, with only a 10% chance for Veterans Day (Wed) and 20% Thursday. Picks: the free Great Gulfcoast Arts Festival and the Greek Festival (both end Sunday) and the Frank Brown songwriter shows are outdoors or mixed. Mozart & Bizet at the Saenger is the indoor pick, and Festa Italiana follows Nov 13-14. Isaias recovery still affects some places, so double-check before heading out.

news.title: Escambia breaks ground on new Myrtle Grove fire station
news.summary: The roughly 12,780-square-foot, three-bay Station 11 is paid for with voter-approved sales tax money; building starts this month with completion expected in fall 2027.

news.title: Three Pensacola men arrested on federal fentanyl charges
news.summary: Searches of several Escambia homes on Oct 29 turned up close to two pounds of fentanyl, firearms and over $100,000 in cash; the men are held pending further proceedings.

news.title: County warns mixed storm debris piles could delay pickup
news.summary: Officials ask residents to keep vegetative and construction debris separate; mixed loads get turned away and can affect FEMA reimbursement. Questions go to 850-332-1226.

news.title: District 4 commission race goes to a recount
news.summary: As of Nov 4 the margin between Hofberger and Vinson was about three votes out of more than 26,000; a machine recount was set to begin Saturday with a possible manual recount Sunday. Final result not confirmed.

news.title: Florida Vibe pro softball team coming to Blue Wahoos Stadium
news.summary: The Professional Softball League club starts play in 2027 with about 20 mostly weekend home games; a free welcome event is set for Nov 16.

news.title: Escambia voters approve renewing the local option sales tax
news.source: Pensacola News Journal via Yahoo News
news.summary: Unofficial results show about 82,000 yes votes to 27,000 no for a 10-year renewal of the one-cent tax, which pays for roads, buildings, stormwater, public safety equipment and other capital needs.

news.title: FEMA individual assistance approved for Escambia and seven other counties
news.summary: Housing, repair and other storm aid was announced Oct 29, with applications through DisasterAssistance.gov.

coverage_note: Updated early Saturday, Nov 7. New this run: Must Do Pensacola's openings roundup and V. Paul's closing, PensacolaBeach.com's November calendar, the Great Gulfcoast Arts Festival hours, WEAR's 7-day forecast and four WEAR/local news stories. Forecast covers only Nov 7-12 because the sources I could read stopped there, and it is much drier than yesterday's for Tue-Wed. Visit Pensacola, Downtown Pensacola, WKRG, the Saenger, team sites and NWS could not be opened, and NorthEscambia.com's cached pages were months old, so no Gonzalez, Molino, Beulah or Cantonment events or openings were confirmed and north Escambia coverage is thin. Emerald Fortress's Nov 4 opening and the recount outcome were not confirmed; later-November and December events are carried over from earlier runs.
